bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge BigBang
bricks.description: Independent initial installer plus separately confirmed BigCrunch removal of every installed Forge package, including BigBang. Preview checks the local package graph and runs a Unity dry run; external dependents and unsafe local sources block removal. Verified removal cleans only exact Forge-owned settings and persists its result before self-unload. Game content, documentation, AI guides and third-party libraries remain.
